title: Attribution

illustrates.quote: Block attributions in the fifth cell to the right of the beginning of the previous line.

blocks.features: Bold, coloured heading with a rule beneath it, in a boxed callout.

blocks.text: In reviewing the case the Court said:

“Its resolution is a matter of national concern, requiring sensitivity both to the Government’s right to protect itself from unlawful subversion and attack and to the citizen’s right to be secure in his privacy against unreasonable government intrusion.”
blocks.features: Displayed/blocked quotation in quotation marks, bold in print.
Right-aligned in print, beneath the quotation.

blocks.text: The government argued that such surveillance was a reasonable exercise of the president’s power
blocks.features: Resumes after the quotation; cut off at the bottom edge of the print image.
